description: Presents reStructuredText documents as a slide deck.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.description: Enables automatic playback controls. notes follows the current tp-text-to-speech[data-slide-notes] and its [trigger=clic] commands; timing advances each progressive step on a clock. Absent or invalid values keep manual navigation.

attributes.name: brand
attributes.description: Legacy brand preset property, such as tp-default. Attribute-driven styling is currently inactive; use the toolbar color control.

attributes.name: git
attributes.description: Repository URL assigned to the toolbar source link when the document shell is created. Set before connecting the component.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Title displayed in the center of the document toolbar.

attributes.name: langs
attributes.description: Comma-separated language codes. The selector is hidden unless at least two distinct codes are declared.

attributes.name: logo
attributes.description: Logo URL displayed at the start of the toolbar, at the default icon-button size. Empty hides the logo.

attributes.name: logo-href
attributes.description: Website opened in the current tab when activating the toolbar logo. Defaults to ./ when omitted or empty.

attributes.name: menu
attributes.description: Opens the navigation sidebar when present; the toolbar Menu button toggles this attribute.

attributes.name: repository
attributes.description: Root path containing the sidebar, cover and linked documents. The component selects the corresponding HTML, Markdown, AsciiDoc or reStructuredText files.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Legacy light, dark or auto property. Attribute-driven styling is currently inactive; use the toolbar theme control.

attributes.name: timing
attributes.description: Positive integer milliseconds per progressive step in timing mode, also used when notes are absent or finished.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.description: Comma-separated controls: home, menu, code, calc, postit, clock, lang, color, theme, screen, fullscreen. Absent or empty keeps all controls; none hides commands. Updates immediately.

dependencies.name: tp-markup-multi-slides
dependencies.summary: presents multi-format pages as a responsive slide deck.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-restructuredtext-multi-slides>` element presents reStructuredText documents as a slide deck.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Manual / Timing / Narration | Select manual navigation, timed steps or narrated notes; the active mode is highlighted. |
| Note | Open or close the current slide's notes; unavailable on slides without notes. |
| Next arrow / click in slide content | Reveal the next progressive step, then advance to the next slide. |
| Previous arrow / right-click in slide content | Hide the previous step, or return to the preceding slide with its steps revealed. |
| Play automatically / Pause automatic playback | When automatic mode is enabled, start playback or pause it without losing the current voice or remaining interval. |
| Stop automatic playback | Cancel automatic playback and keep the current slide. |
| Speaker notes, when supplied | Open the notes panel or use its speech controls without advancing the slide. |
| Slide slider | Drag to select a slide directly; its progressive content starts again from the beginning. |
| Navigation menu, when shown | Choose a slide directly and stop automatic playback. |
| Links, buttons and fields inside slides | Keep their usual behavior; interacting with them does not advance the slide. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> outside editing controls | Reveal the next step or advance to the next slide. |
| <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> / <kbd>Backspace</kbd> outside editing controls | Hide the preceding step or return to the previous slide. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> on the slide slider | Choose a slide. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> on the slide slider | Choose the first or last slide. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
